proof_explanation: The negate function is corrected to return Bool.not(value) instead of returning the input value unchanged. This implements proper total Boolean negation: for any input Boolean value, negate(value) now correctly equals Bool.not(value). The law proof negate_matches_boolean_not validates this equivalence through reflexivity, as negate now directly applies the same operation as Bool.not.

seeded_attack.reason: This source implements identity instead of negation, violating the law negate_matches_boolean_not. The function returns its input unchanged, so negate(true) = true but Bool.not(true) = false, causing the equality to fail. This does not implement total Boolean negation.
